experiment: scoped eligibility-policy adaptation with fixed context fallback; offline only

suiteLock.protocol: All manifests locked before any run; all seeds scored, no seed filtering or policy tuning on final labels. This suite is development stress evidence, not a pristine deployment qualification set.

sourceHashConvention: Rust/Cargo source paths refer to frozen-source/ in the local benchmark directory; report scripts refer to the working tree.

environment.sourceState: Evaluated source files are untracked; use sourceHashes and binary hashes, not HEAD alone.
environment.execution: sequential local release executable; temporary SQLite; no model loaded
environment.measurement: sysctl model/CPU/memory, sw_vers and local compiler queried on benchmark host; serial numbers not collected
environment.resourceLimits: Shared host; power mode, peak RAM and sustained thermal behavior not measured.

limitations: Authored feedback and simple lexical topics; fresh seeds are not independent real-user qualification.
Fixed context fallback and same-initialization global controller distinguish starting-point gains from scoping gains.
No production integration, new acoustic inference, native UI latency, battery or thermal qualification.
Scope changes preserve existing fresh gates but provide no historical or future non-regression guarantee.
